resolutions.reasoning: NXP includes xhci.h for PORT_POWER/HC_LENGTH/HCS_MAX_PORTS macros used in dwc3_power_off_all_roothub_ports. Mainline adds xhci-plat.h for the new xhci_plat_priv struct. Both are needed.

NXP adds platform data from dwc3_pdata if present. Mainline adds dwc3_xhci_plat_quirk to set XHCI_SKIP_PHY_INIT quirk. Both need to coexist - if NXP has private data, use it; otherwise apply the mainline quirk. Since dwc3_xhci_plat_quirk is a struct xhci_plat_priv, we should pass it when NXP's platdata isn't provided.
